name: Mahaganapati Temple, Ranjangaon
summary: Ranjangaon’s Mahaganapati often closes the Ashtavinayak circuit for Pune-based pilgrims.
mythology: Mahaganapati Temple, Ranjangaon at Ranjangaon, Pune district, Maharashtra is dedicated to Lord Ganesha (Mahaganapati), known especially for Ashtavinayak — powerful Mahaganapati form. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Lord Ganesha (Mahaganapati) blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
